digest.component_or_area: Mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutant counts in signing.py are stale (814 mutants vs. 491 old record), including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps, blocking enforcement of legacy ceilings.

Mutation shard enforcement must transition through three modes (advisory→ratchet→strict) with explicit manifest-driven timeout policies and per-shard promotion criteria based on stable base/head comparisons and runtime thresholds.

Advisory mode runs head-only evidence collection and publishes all outcomes nonblocking except for missing, zero-mutant, incomplete, or configuration/execution failures; ratchet preserves unchanged legacy survivors while blocking new regressions; strict requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted as equivalent.

Selector must map changed source, test, support, and global mutation-infrastructure changes to affected shards, emit deterministic JSON, handle renames and deletions, and produce an explicit empty-selection success state.

Workflow matrix derives per-shard 30-minute jobs from selector output, uses fresh isolated base/head archives with no persisted verdict cache, pins mutmut 3.7.0 with --max-children 1, and always publishes structured evidence and artifacts.

Documentation must describe live manifest policy, phased promotion process with deterministic evidence thresholds, and remove stale score/budget tables; a contract test enforces the required sections and rejects legacy headings.
